controls.scope: Production HTML/CSP/JS button and extension callback with real Native Git; VS Code transport/window/pickers are replaced. No real user worktree writes or OS window focus.

limits: Owned local bare remotes; no Captain mutation or real GitHub network speed measurement.
Parent Node CPU includes Playwright transport, excludes Git/Chromium/hooks/OS. Matrix RSS is sampled incremental Node RSS, not total application RSS.

One retained candidate is limited by 4096 entries,65536 memberships and4MiB conservative estimated text/object size; this is not an exact heap/RSS guarantee. No added timer or extra validation Git command.
Initial button comparison used a first fetch that creates origin/HEAD and therefore legitimately changes refs. Its failed expectation and samples are preserved as diagnostic, not headline timing.
Final unchanged-fetch fixture first prepares native remote HEAD, then asserts every full ref/OID is unchanged. Same corrected harness is used for both sources.
Consecutive unavailable history proofs explicitly invalidate, including the Native no-prefetch regression. All fresh branch/config/operation safety gates remain.
Broad named-operation matrices prove final-state correctness only; n3/source paired timing is limited to unchanged fetch and loaded checkout. Full goal remains active.
No Marketplace status query, foreground Extension Host, OS focus change or forced reload.
